results.corrected_title: Fal raises $1.3bn Series F led by Bessemer at a $16bn valuation
results.corrected_summary: Fal, a San Francisco generative media and AI inference platform, announced a $1.3bn Series F led by Bessemer Venture Partners on 3 Nov 2026. The round values the company at $16bn, double the $8bn valuation from April. Nvidia, Sound Ventures, HOF Capital and T. Rowe Price also took part. Fal says the Series E and F together raised $1.65bn.
key_facts: Amount: $1.3bn Series F, led by Bessemer Venture Partners
Participants: Nvidia, Sound Ventures, T. Rowe Price and HOF Capital
